name: Search LinkedIn jobs for referral targets
description: Search LinkedIn Jobs by role×geo, open JDs, keep postings matching REFERRAL_JD_KEYWORDS. Writes jobs.json.

env.name: REFERRAL_DRY_RUN
env.description: Dry-run flag (search is read-only either way)

env.name: REFERRAL_ROLES
env.default: Full Stack Developer,MERN Stack Developer,React Developer

env.name: REFERRAL_JD_KEYWORDS
env.description: Keep job if description matches any keyword

env.name: REFERRAL_MAX_JOBS
env.description: Max matched jobs to keep this run

env.name: REFERRAL_RUN_ID
env.description: Run folder under data/referral/ (new id if unset on search)
